name: How a girl dragged me along on a geocaching adventure
source:
You encounter a strange girl while trying out a new hobby.  Shenanigans ensue.

[From [url=https://goldenarrow7778.itch.io/how-a-girl-dragged-me-along-on-a-geocaching-adventure]itch.io[/url]]

你在尝试一项新爱好——地理寻宝（Geocaching）时偶遇了一位古怪的少女，一连串啼笑皆非的闹剧就此展开。

[摘自[url=https://goldenarrow7778.itch.io/how-a-girl-dragged-me-along-on-a-geocaching-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
